author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Banana Pi has announced public availability of its BPI-AI2N embedded vision platform, following the hardware introduction covered last year. The platform combines a system-on-module based on the Renesas RZ/V2N Vision AI MPU with a separate carrier board designed for smart cameras, industrial vision, robotics, and other edge AI applications. title: Banana Pi BPI-AI2N Goes on Sale with Yocto and Armbian Images
